name: feedback
title_zh: 录坏了别忍，直接去官方工单骂一句
tagline_zh: 录音出错、命令失败、工具该换个活法——不用在本地仓库里留痕，一键跳去公开工单，把问题甩给真正能改代码的人。
tagline_en: Broken recording, failed command, or a feature request? Jump straight to the public tracker—no local repo.
desc_en: Report a problem with webapp-evidence itself, or ask for something it cannot do yet, on its public issue tracker. Use when a recording came out wrong, a command failed, or the user says the tool should work differently. Writes nothing in the user's own repository.
why_zh: 它把「反馈」和「改代码」焊死在同一跳转里，不让你在本地仓库里写小作文，逼着问题回到它该去的地方。
why_en: It hard-wires feedback to the codebase's issue tracker, so problems land where they're actually fixed—not in your local notes.
limit_zh: 只负责打开工单页面并预填描述，不代写、不提交、不追踪。若你所在网络无法访问公开工单，或团队要求走内部流程。
limit_en: Only opens the tracker and pre-fills a draft. Won't submit, track, or handle internal/offline workflows. Useless if the tracker is unreachable.
title_en: Open the official issue tracker when a recording goes wrong
